title: Committed Room Nights of a Group Room Blocks Increase
content:
The committed room nights of a Group Room Blocks increase are the commitment share of the room nights the increase addendum requests, rounded down to a whole room night; the room nights requested beyond them are held for the group without entering the contract. The commitment share of an increase is 100 percent. The days before arrival of an increase are counted as whole calendar days to the block's arrival date from the date the increase addendum is implemented.

### Definitions

- **Room nights requested** — the requested room nights written on the most recently issued increase addendum whose status is signed.
- **Commitment share** — 100 percent.
- **Committed room nights** — the commitment share of the room nights requested, rounded down to a whole room night.
- **Held but not committed** — the room nights requested less the committed room nights; they are held for the group without entering the contract.
- **Days before arrival of the increase** — whole calendar days from the date the increase addendum is implemented to the block's arrival date.

### Worked figures (hypothetical signed increase addenda)

| Room nights requested | Commitment share | Committed room nights | Held without entering the contract |
|---|---|---|---|
| 30 | 100 percent | 30 | 0 |
| 7 | 100 percent | 7 | 0 |

Implemented 75 calendar days before the block's arrival date, an increase counts 75 days before arrival.
